payload.description: A guide to using Claude's visualization capabilities to transform 24 months of financial data into a storytelling board deck with capital allocation analysis. Upload your P&L, let Claude categorize business units by risk profile, and build side-by-side capital allocation paths — work that used to take a finance team weeks with a Big 4 firm, done in a single chat. Based on Wouter Born's workflow shared with 35,000+ CFOs.
payload.name: How to Turn a P&L into a Board-Ready Capital Allocation Deck with Claude
payload.title: How to Turn a P&L into a Board-Ready Capital Allocation Deck with Claude
